catalog_info.title: European Digital Infrastructure Open Data Portal
catalog_info.description: Official open data catalog for the European Digital Infrastructure Authority (EDIA), aggregating datasets from all divisions and partner agencies.

datasets.title: Cross-Border Payment Transaction Volumes
datasets.description: Quarterly aggregated cross-border payment flows between EU member states via SEPA infrastructure, broken down by originating and destination country, payment type, and value band.

distributions.title: Full Dataset CSV
distributions.description: Complete quarterly payment flow data in CSV format with ISO country codes

distributions.title: Summary Statistics PDF
distributions.description: Quarterly summary statistics report in PDF format

datasets.title: EU Cybersecurity Incident Reports
datasets.description: Anonymized and aggregated cybersecurity incident data reported by member state CERTs, classified by attack vector, impact severity, and affected sector.

distributions.title: Incident Database JSON-LD
distributions.description: Machine-readable incident records in JSON-LD format with STIX 2.1 compatible structure

datasets.title: Digital Single Market Regulatory Corpus
datasets.description: Machine-readable collection of EU digital regulations, directives, and implementing acts including the Digital Services Act, Digital Markets Act, and AI Act.

distributions.title: Full Corpus Akoma Ntoso XML
distributions.description: Complete regulatory corpus in Akoma Ntoso XML format

distributions.title: Metadata RDF/XML Export
distributions.description: Bibliographic metadata for all regulatory documents in RDF/XML

distributions.title: Full-Text Search API
distributions.description: RESTful search API for the regulatory corpus with faceted search support

datasets.title: European Broadband Coverage Map Data
datasets.description: Geospatial data on fixed and mobile broadband infrastructure coverage across EU member states at NUTS-3 level, including technology type and speed tiers.

distributions.title: GeoJSON Coverage Data
distributions.description: Full coverage map polygons in GeoJSON format

distributions.title: WMS Tile Service Endpoint
distributions.description: OGC Web Map Service for broadband coverage visualization

datasets.title: AI Systems Risk Classification Registry
datasets.description: Registry of AI systems classified by risk level under the EU AI Act framework, including provider information, intended use, and conformity assessment status.

distributions.title: Registry Export JSON
distributions.description: Complete AI systems registry export in JSON format

distributions.title: Registry CSV Summary
distributions.description: Tabular summary of classified AI systems

datasets.title: eIDAS Trust Service Status Lists
datasets.description: Consolidated trust service status information from all EU member state trusted lists under eIDAS regulation, including qualified and non-qualified service providers.

distributions.title: ETSI Trusted Lists XML
distributions.description: ETSI TS 119 612 compliant XML trusted lists

data_services.title: EDIA SPARQL Query Service
data_services.description: Public SPARQL 1.1 endpoint providing federated query access across all published EDIA open datasets with content negotiation support.

data_services.title: EDIA OGC Geospatial Feature Service
data_services.description: OGC Web Feature Service 2.0 providing programmatic access to geospatial datasets with GML and GeoJSON output formats.
